rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an employee of a company or organization.

example.english: The employee benefits at this company are quite good.
example.traditional: 呢間公司嘅員工福利幾好。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jyun4 gung1 fuk1 lei6 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this colloquial term when emphasizing an ordinary wage earner rather than the company’s staff in formal terms.

example.traditional: 我只係一個普通打工仔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 pou2 tung1 daa2 gung1 zai2

rows.note: Use this formal term in legal, administrative, or employment-related writing.

example.english: Every employee must follow the company regulations.
example.traditional: 每個僱員都必須遵守公司規例。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 gu3 jyun4 dou1 bit1 seoi1 zeon1 sau2 gung1 si1 kwai1 lai6
